title: pyrethrum tatsienense
intro: Pyrethrum tatsienense, commonly known as Chinese pyrethrum or Tatsienense pyrethrum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant is used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, and its therapeutic actions, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrethrum tatsienense include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues.
